title: Import from source URL
description: Asks an external AI to read an article, podcast, or video and extract its most compelling argument as a Symthink tree for paste-back.

variables.name: articleUrl
variables.description: Normalized http(s) URL of the source to read.

surfaces: My Vision → Options → Import from source URL (`import_from_article`: any Question, Idea, or Claim)

usage.notes: Pasted tree is attached as a new child of the Options subject (not flattened onto it).
